reason: I don't take supplements unless my doctor says to, and nobody has told me I'm low on magnesium. A lab report is nice, but it doesn't tell me I need this.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? And I have no proof I need it at all. $30 a month is a lot for something my doctor hasn't recommended.
